profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a driven software development professional, always seeking to grow and deepen my expertise. With a strong focus on Analysis and Design of solutions based on Technologies such as Java 11+, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, SQL, NoSQL, and AWS, I actively contribute to every phase of the software development lifecycle, ensuring the application of best practices and design patterns in all solutions.

Throughout my career, I have developed a wide range of projects, including streaming platforms, banking systems, accounting solutions, HR management systems, and supply chain platforms. I am committed to delivering high-quality, scalable solutions that meet business needs and exceed expectations.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Client: Disney

Main Achievements/Recognitions:
●	Improved ad streaming efficiency by 10% using optimized ffmpeg commands.
●	Successfully implemented a scalable multi-platform login system with a 99.9% uptime rate.
●	Implemented a bulk update algorithm to migrate old versions to new ones.

Responsibilities:
●	Analysis designed and developed core backend functionalities using Java 11+, Spring Boot, and PostgreSQL.
●	Developed RESTful APIs to support cross-platform integrations and real-time ad serving.
●	Utilized Kafka for asynchronous message processing, enhancing system performance.
●	Utilized AWS services (S3, RDS, EC2) to ensure scalability and reliability.
●	Implemented Kafka for event-driven communication, reducing latency and improving system performance.
●	Conducted code reviews, mentored junior developers, and ensured adherence to best practices.
●	Collaborated with cross-functional teams using Agile methodologies, including daily stand-ups and sprint planning.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Client: Citi Banamex
Project Description: Analysis and maintained critical banking web services for account management and communication processes. Projects included remote account opening and transaction monitoring, requiring secure, reliable, and scalable solutions to meet strict regulatory standards.

Main Achievements/Recognitions:
●	Delivered the "Remote Account Opening" project, enabling a 30% increase in online customer acquisition.
●	Implemented Spring Cloud solutions that reduced API response times by 15%.
●	Recognized for leading a cross-functional team to deliver key project milestones ahead of schedule.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer Team Lead
positions.description:
Client: Mexicana MRO

Project Description: Developed a comprehensive HR management platform, integrating payroll, employee records, and compliance tracking. Focused on enhancing user experience and backend scalability.

Main Achievements/Recognitions:
●	Designed and deployed a payroll module reducing manual errors by 25%.
●	Migrated legacy systems to a cloud-based solution, improving accessibility and reducing downtime.
●	Implemented a secure login system using Spring Security and OAuth.
